gnssSource: /novatel/oem7/bestpos XY; reported uncertainty projected to UTM; recorded solution types are INS aided
lidarSource: Fresh raw-scan whole-pillar coarse D2D measurements

matching.source: Fresh raw-scan whole-pillar coarse D2D measurements

replay.motionSource: four-wheel speed and corrected gyro with actual lateral-observer velocity; causal zero-order hold
replay.clockSource: INSPVA receiver GPS seconds interpolated on ROS stamp; edge extrapolation only
replay.reference: INSPVA interpolated pose at LiDAR acquisition time
replay.knownTilt: recorded GNSS/INS roll/pitch through quaternion yaw/tilt decomposition
replay.timingScope: map crop, fresh coarse perception, D2D and pose event; excludes disk read and offline preparation
replay.diskLoading: blocks loaded before processing; diskLoadMs is block time divided by block frame count
replay.mapOverlap: same sequence used for mapping and query; includes query observations

matching.limitations: same sequence used for mapping and query; includes query observations; recursive matching initialization

synchronization.clock: Native LiDAR frames; no synthetic inter-frame localization outputs
synchronization.inputScope: Wheel/lateral estimates retain their native preprocessing; only aligned frame values enter localization

evaluation: INSPVA on native LiDAR frame timestamps, approximately 10 Hz

gnssOutputPointCalibration.convention: BESTPOS point minus observer/map INSPVA output point; forward/left metres; subtract R(estimated yaw)*offset
gnssOutputPointCalibration.interpretation: Independent-drive empirical relative output-point calibration, not a surveyed antenna-to-CG lever arm
gnssOutputPointCalibration.uncertainty: Per-sample robust training residual sigma with 0.05 m floor per body axis; declared 1 degree heading sigma; unknown receiver correlations

initialization: Common first LiDAR pose plus wheel/lateral velocity and IMU acceleration; not a cold-start GNSS-only test
limitations: same sequence used for mapping and query; includes query observations; recursive matching initialization; shared receiver reference; empirical planar output-point alignment is not a hardware survey; upstream motion preparation offline

callPathAudit.scope: One independent frame-1 localizeLidarFrame call; same entry used on every replay scan
